notes.title: New Content - Cultivation Pond!
notes.content: [h1]📢 Hello Farm Managers! 🚜[/h1][p]➡️2nd free content update is here⬅️[/p][p] [/p][p]As many of you eagle-eyed players were able to spot, we have 2 new scenarios and achievements for completing them.[/p][p] [/p][p]They are created to familiarize you with new resources:[/p][p]- Lotos[/p][p]- Pickle lotos steams[/p][p]- Nori[/p][p]- Hosomaki[/p][p] [/p][p]Both Nori and Lotos are delicate and susceptible to temperature changes. So be careful when you plant them. It can be grown on water in a new type of building.[/p][h1]Cultivation Pond[/h1][p]Try a new way to grow plants. Place them gently on the water surface, keep an eye on the weather, and help them blossom into beautiful plants.[/p][p][i]You can find it in the “Other” section of the Build tab.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300664/e8347068a0f5c3abf287a60fa5abbe998b66c4f6.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Lotos[/b] - Beautiful water flower that will add class to your farm. Put their steams in a jar, top up with brine. Enjoy them with another one of your senses.[/p][p][i]You'll need a Vegetable Processing Plant to create Pickle lotos steams.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300664/97996ca29a6852e535f6e1e71fc0c52261cda2e2.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Nori[/b] - Seaweed that all you Sushi-heads can’t live without. Add some rice and shrimp, roll everything up, and you have tasty hosomaki.[/p][p][i]You'll need a Food Processing Plant to create Hosomaki.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]To hone your skills, we created two scenarios focused on new buildings.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Asian Delicacy[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300664/60245ccad5db3ce218b68769a62f94240d4c1fcc.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Lotos Flower[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300664/0cf5d666dc031664284c50b1eb79c9de545d0791.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]We warmly invite you to play, review, stream, and share your videos using #farmmanagerworld #TimeToFarm🌾[/p][p]⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️[/p][p] [/p][p]Besides that, we are consistently listening to your feedback on our Discord and Steam.[/p][p]Here's the list of Fixes and Adjustments that we made besides the new content:[/p][list][*][p]Forage Harvester could now get damaged, as other machines (the machine was unable to be damaged).[/p][/*][*][p]Rodon Cultivator can now be painted.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where having 0 item amount to buy in the market would result in the entire purchase not being completed.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed some Polish translations regarding training.[/p][/*][*][p]There are no more scenario descriptions on the saved games panels.[/p][/*][*][p]Bok Choy plant is no longer levitating.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where the 'Escape' button would turn off the wrong menu windows.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue with displaying the message about the Seasonal Staff joining field during work.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p]

notes.title: ➡️First content update is here⬅️

And of course, you can use it on your fields or sell it to other farmers.[/p][p]You can unlock it by completing the “[b]Nothing Goes to Waste[/b]” Training.[/p][p]You can check when your crops will change into Waste in the Plant Compendium under Product expires.[/p][p]Choose up to 5 different fabrics to create in your own

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300664/87e491d75e48a4c17ace8fac59758fb6a8da6b88.png"][/img][/p][p]Nothing dies, everything returns[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300664/1beb6f7f52a7c9d99f80b176b2d080a9eee221a9.png"][/img][/p][p]After completing them, you’ll earn two new [b]Achievements[/b].[/p][p]We warmly invite you to play, review, stream, and share your videos using #farmmanagerworld #TimeToFarm🌾

[/p][p]Here's the list of Fixes and Adjustments that we made besides the new content:[/p][list][*][p]Adjusted America's small Warehouse to fit the grid better[/p][/*][*][p]Added panel to Field Modal to inform about seasonal staff join during work mechanic.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new label to save to mark it as multiplayer host/client.[/p][/*][*][p]Multiplayer Client saves can no longer be loaded as single player saves.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed translations for Earn Money scenario condition to have "Earn X" instead of "Have X" in its Header in order to be more precise.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed translations for Advanced Glasshouse training regarding having seeded plants inside glasshouses.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue that caused 'Purchased All Vehicles' achievement to not trigger after last vehicle purchase (had to wait for next day).[/p][/*][*][p]"Skip tutorial" button in Europe Campaign should now skip more steps.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated animals conditions (and their translations) in scenarios to be more precise with "Have" or "Buy/Breed" tasks.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where production buildings would sometimes take more resources than necessary.[/p][/*][*][p]Back to menu button will now show different message than to "quit" the game.[/p][/*][*][p]"Quit Game" panel should now have centered text instead of left-aligned.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed 'Water' resource from market, warehouse manager, supply demand and - buildings (resource had no purpose).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where bought machines could be offset from parking spaces and nothing could be done about them.[/p][/*][*][p]Trying to destroy electric pole from Europe's Campaign step too soon, will now have message.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted some tutorial highlights in campaigns (Hiring Seasonal Staff, Glasshouse temperature, Training Manager).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where Item & Animal Autotrade buttons worked if autotrade options were not selected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue in Europe Campaign where all of Staff would have only Shipping ability even after completing task with assigning to Owner's House.

notes.title: The 1.0 patch for Farm Manager World
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300664/dd4b1ba43958952b98dde0785b48de9229af5812.png[/img]
[h1]📢 Hello Farm Managers! 🚜 [/h1]
After nearly a year of hard work 👩‍💻🧑‍💻👨‍💻
[b][h2]➡️The 1.0 patch for Farm Manager World is now live!⬅️[/h2][/b]
But that’s not all — we’re not stopping here! We are preparing new content, including new machines and other surprises! 🎁
We warmly invite you to play, review, stream, and share your videos using #farmmanagerworld #TimeToFarm🌾
⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ 

[h3]What will you find new in Farm Manager Word that wasn't in Farm Manager 2021?[/h3]
• 3 new Campaigns
• 8 new scenarios 
• 3 multiplayer scenarios 
• Regions of the world (Europe, Central America, Asia) 
  --> Various climate, terrain, vegetation
  --> Changed some buildings look based on region
• Fields and work in the fields 
  --> More metrics for fields: soil class, pH, nitrogen levels.
  --> Crop rotation
  --> Connecting/disconnecting fields
  --> Possibility of automatic mechanical/manual operation or independent selection of vehicles and workers 
  --> Ability to add workers to ongoing field work
• Crops 
  --> 80 crop species (32 new)
  --> Plants compedium
• Animals
  --> Cyclic ordering/selling of animals
  --> Young animals
  --> 20 species of animals (3 new +2)
  --> Distinguishing between laying and meat hens
  -->Distinguishing between dairy and meat cows
• Vehicles 
  --> 35 refreshed vehicles and machines (new orchard tractor)
  --> Fuel
• Manufacturing plants 
  --> New processing plants including biorefinery
  --> Many new product types
  --> Ability to create more production lines
• Multiplayer 
  --> Exchange of products and machines
  --> Collaborative completion of scenario objectives
  --> Shared free game
• Employees
  --> Changed skills system
  --> New look
  --> Choosing if employee can be a driver
• Mods support 
• Planning mode for creating farm layout
• Trading Contracts 
• More leasing options
• Help Center 
• Logistic system 
• Resource orders in warehouses 
• New trainings 
 • Refreshed and expanded interface 
 • Improved graphics and optimization

notes.title: Patch 2025.01.29
notes.content:
- changed several conditions in Campaigns from "Building X of Building" to "Have X of Building" to avoid issues with building unnecessary ones
- fixed text clipping in Multiplayer section of MainMenu in Ultra Wide resolutions
- added label when selecting machine in Machine Market to display minimal staff cout to use it (for example: Combines/Reapers require 2 staff as one is needed for Combine and one for Tractor)
- fixed Client with several mods active being allowed to join lobby where Host did not have any mods active

notes.title: Patch 2025.01.23
notes.content:
- contracts will now finalize and move to history contracts upon sending all resources, both in singleplayer and multiplayer
- increased not produced resource contract duration range from 8 - 28 days to 27 - 47
- additionally increased not produced foliage resource contract duration range to 27-47 days plus Plant GrowthTime in days
- Campaign Dialog window will now hide empty space if there is no button to be pressed
- increased clickable area for Work Toggles in Staff List view in Staff Manager
- fixed sold resources being saved, allowing for infinite money
 - start and end date input fields in Seasonal Staff Building are now using DD.MM format regardless of Language/Culture of the System
 - fixed perrenial plants like Grass or Prickly Pear having their growth restarted after falling into hibernation if field has more then 1 Plant set in Crop Rotation
 - fixed wrong message in Portuguese asking player to call veterinarian instead of "Need X more space in warehouse"

notes.title: Hotfix 20215.01.20
notes.content: reveted "fixed completed sell contracts not being moved to History Contracts section in Multiplayer, resulting in money being paid out endlessly"

notes.title: Patch 0.8.20250117.399
notes.content:
- added ability to upload new version of mod. You need to be subscribed to your own mod, place new version of mod into local "mods" folder (done automatically if mod was compiled via Unity Editor) and click "Update" button to update your mod.
- increased base initial cooldown between fires on fields from 30 days to 90 days
- cooldown between fires now lowers linearly with each new field back to 30 days at 20 fields
- fixed "Soil parameters" toggle being squished on Ultra Wide resolutions
- fixed hired seasonal staff tooltip over house displaying wrong number in Asia campaign (it displayed 12 instead of 2)
- fixed Achievements in Scenarios sometimes not unlocking when selecting one of the options. It will now give Achievement when ending scren is shown
- fixed "Not Growing" field state being displayed as "Raked" when selected Plant was Grass
- fixed Two-Lane road being free if it crossed at last one Road piece
- increased first Two-Lane road piece cost from 200 to 400
- changed misleading price of Two-Lane road from 200 to 400. When placing Two-Lane roads, cost was incremented by 400, not by 200.
- fixed "Mateusz Kupiec" with blank face appearing in Field Modal when Seasonal Staff working on field were past their end hire date
- Sugarcane is now perrenial plant to compensate for long growing time
- fixed error message related to selected animal food appearing in "Taco Restaurant" scenario
- fixed being able to place buildings and roads inside few hills in Europe
- fixed "add suggested products" button appearing even after buying them
- fixed sent money amount to another Player not being updated every time amount is changed through Input Field (you had to unfocus Input Field for it to work or press Enter)
- fixed completed sell contracts not being moved to History Contracts section in Multiplayer, resulting in money being paid out endlessly
- switched blocked buildings around in "Organic Business" Multiplayer Scenario, now Host cannot produce seeds and Client cannot build Animal Buildings
- Host in "Organic Business" Multiplayer Scenario now has blocked "Seeds and Seedling Production" Building
- fixed softblock "Organic Business" Multiplayer Scenario when Player could not produce organic meat (Player now starts with "Organic Farm Certificate" training)
- fixed Field Modal not showing progress during any Call

notes.title: Major Update!
notes.content:
Dear Farm Manager Enjoyers!

We've just released a major game update. Update your game, and you will find the following new features:

[list]
[*] a new Region: Asia – high temperatures, higher rainfall and even higher opportunities.
[*] a new Campaign: Asia – a traditional farm in a remote province… As a financial crisis looms, scale up and stay afloat, allying with local farmers.
[*] Vietnamese Pot-Bellied Pigs, Bamboo farming, and Bamboo processed food added to the game.
[*] new Achievements. Unlock them when progressing the Asia Campaign.
[*] new Trading Partners, specific to Asia.
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/JhyTpzkj]Cleversan Games Discord[/url]
[*] 7 new Avatars for Steam community (Steam will randomly pick 5 for you to choose from).
[*] a new orange Creature that enjoys walking on keyboardsjlkjionhuoiphuihnuip;nhe
[/list]

Other changes:

[list]
[*] improved the tooltip in MainMenu when selecting a multiplayer Scenario to provide information about tasks and blocked features.
[*] improved Staff behaviour during manual fertilizing. If a worker runs out of fertilizer, they will take more fertilizer as needed.
[*] improved how Machines (particularly Tractors) are selected for Field work. Now Orchard Tractor can be selected if it meets the power requirement.
[*] Soil Layer will now be automatically enabled when placing a Glasshouse (note that Soil Class still does not affect it).
[*] updated the Help Center
[*] changed how the selected food in Animal Buildings is saved. 
[/list]
Due to potential compatbility issues, you will see a one-time warning when loading a save, informing about this issue. 
Additionally, some food will be selected to reduce the danger of animal starvation.
[list]
[*] changed the coverage of "Select trading partner" button to include the "Selected partner".
[*] changed Bread to be counted in as units instead of in weight.
[*] changed Bakery price from 408 000 to 120 000.
[*] changed machines used in Red Beans harvest due to the removal of multiharvest property.
[*] changed some textures in both crates and Chest Trailers when transporting plant resources.
[*] increased harvest yields on all plants to make them more profitable. (The change has been made to make plant based farms more competetive in comparison to mass animal husbandry. New values are subject to change if logistic issues start to crop up.)
[*] changed Delivery Truck capacity from 10000 to 15000 (affects the Logistic Building).
[*] increased the harvest multiplier from Orchard and Plants abilities from 125% to 150%. 
[*] increased the Seasonal Staff multiplier from 75% to 100%
[*] reduced base Seasonal Staff wage to 600 from 1200. (Seasonal Staff were underutilised due to having lower efficiency than Machine farming. This change aims to reduce cost of running farms using larger workforce with lower Machine count.)
[*] changed Wage multiplier on difficulty settings from 75% (Easy), 150% (Hard) and 200% (Extreme) to 80% (Easy), 125% (Hard), 150% (Extreme). 
[*] changed Fuel multiplier on difficulty settings from 120% (Hard) and 150% (Extreme) to 133% (Hard) and 200% (Extreme).
[*] changed both Yield size and Price of products multiplier on difficulty settings from 85% (Hard) and 70% (Extreme) to 90% (Hard) and 80% (Extreme). (Due to multiplicative nature, old values caused income from fields to be 72% (Hard) and 49% (Extreme) of Normal difficulty income (100%). Current values are 81% (Hard) and 64% (Extreme). Those changes were made to make Extreme more manageable while still providing challenge. We are considering adding the ability to customize those values by players in the future. Send comments on Steam Forum if you would like to see such an addition.)
[*] changed prices on several products.
[*] when selecting crop rotation on a Field, Organic (BIO) checkbox will be on if Field is currently Organic.
[*] removed unnecessary warning when demolishing a Pump that maintains irrigation on a Field if that Field has another Pump in range.
[*] removed the requirement for unlocking Middle America Campaign, you can now access it even if you have not finished the European Campaign.
[/list]

Bug fixes:

[list]
[*] fixed Staff and Machines being stuck in the Owner's House due to floating point error when retrieving Resources.
[*] fixed Staff being stuck on Field after finishing harvest. Error would occur on Fields with crop rotation after switching to Plant that produces Hay.
[*] fixed CampaignInfoPanel (where Tom or Miguel resides) covering too much of the Field Modal.
[*] fixed the Gas Station paying for 1 unit of Fuel when ordering lagre amounts of fuel instead, ripping the fuel vendor off in the proccess.
[*] fixed "No resource order" warning lingering after deleting a building that created this warning.
[*] fixed sometimes not being able to start manual fertilizing through Field Work Modal, even if free Staff number was equal to the number of Staff needed.
[*] fixed some Production Resources not being visible in the "Produces" section when hovering on Production Buildings in the Build Menu.
[*] fixed Grass not being visible in a Self-Loading Trailer.
[*] fixed "Available in later part of campaign" message not being visible on the Start Training Button.
[*] fixed several texts being blurry in the UI.
[*] fixed demand indicators in the lower left corner showing resources from the incorrect pool.
[*] other smaller fixes.
[*] updated localization files.
[/list]

Get in the tractor, take a Vietnamese Pot-Bellied Pig with you and join us as our Farm Manager World journey contiunes.

More updates coming soon!

Yours,
Cleversan Games Team
